# Switchbak

> Switchbak carries the sessions of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode) from a Mac to the warehouse of an organization. Each pull request then gets a Receipt: a check run and a comment that record the sessions behind the change.

- The client runs only on a Mac with Apple silicon. It does not run on an Intel Mac, on Windows or on Linux.
- Install with `brew install switchbackai/tap/switchbak`, then run `switchbak login` and sign in with GitHub (`switchbak login --device` on a machine with no browser). Login makes the account and its organization, and the uploads start. It needs no GitHub App.
- `switchbak connect` installs the GitHub App, so that pull requests get a Receipt.
- `switchbak status` prints the state of an installation. Without the GitHub App it prints `github    Receipts on pull requests are off`; uploads and Audits still run. `switchbak audit -json <path>` prints the Audit of a session as JSON.
- Each member of an organization can read every session of it. A GitHub member is a person with access to an installation of the GitHub App that the organization connected. When the access ends, run `switchbak login` after access returns. An admin removes a member on the members page.

## Docs

- [User guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/switchbackai/docs/main/GUIDE.md): install, log in with GitHub, connect the GitHub App, join a team, read a Receipt, log in again, manage members, and each command of the CLI.
- [Where your data goes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/switchbackai/docs/main/DATA-NOTICE.md): what the client reads, what the warehouse masks, where each copy of a session is held, who can read it, and what erase removes.
